events.title: MTV's 45th anniversary
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV changed the game for music and television. Remember watching it for the first time?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, the counterculture converged at Woodstock. Three days of peace, love, and music that made history.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Tribute
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still packing a punch with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still Definitely Maybe the best.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Licence to thrill! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic debut. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music legend and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.
